scenes.summary: You've found Endfield's Stock Redistributor, "Lucky Carrot." Once authorized, she will use stock bills to purchase and sell goods, coordinating supply and demand within the area.

lines.text: Ah, you're finally here! I've been waiting quite a while.
What do you mean? I am an Endfield operator!
Endfield Industries Stock Redistributor, Lucky Carrot, reporting for duty!
Image-building matters! During emergencies, it's Endfield's duty to help coordinate local resources and assist those in need.
It's always better to negotiate with a smile than to make demands with a stern face.
But so many parts of Valley IV are still cut off. I'm really worried about everyone out there...
Once you authorize it, we'll use Band Accord-approved ⟦key|stock bills⟧ to manage supplies and balance local demand.
I'll also keep an eye out for suitable goods on your behalf, Endmin. Just use your stock bills to claim them.
Exactly! Once things stabilize, this system will be capable of much more.
I've tucked a few ⟦key|little surprises⟧ into the cargo manifest. If you're ready to authorize now, just confirm with me!

options: Looks like this role really calls for a personal touch.
I'm having a hard time picturing how you work...
So, is there anything I can do?
We shall return to the topic at hand.
So ... it's basically a shop that uses stock bills?

scenes.summary: Lucky Carrot informs you that investing more stock bills will upgrade the stock redistribution system.

lines.text: Mhm... Order confirmed for Mr. Rammu's purchase.
You can place orders anytime through the stock redistribution system. Pretty convenient, right?
Well, this is just a coordination tool. It won't disrupt normal economic activity.
If anyone tries to exploit this to hoard and manipulate prices, that's another matter entirely... If you see it happening, please be sure to tell me!
Ah, also, you can invest more stock bills to ⟦key|upgrade⟧ the stock redistribution system in this area.
That way, I can offer you a wider variety of goods. Just remember, here in Valley IV, we only use ⟦key|Valley Stock Bills⟧.
That's right, but that would take more time to explain.
If you're interested, feel free to come find me anytime!

options: We're using stock bills instead of T-Creds now?
You mentioned it can do more?

r: We're using stock bills instead of T-Creds now?

lines.text: Endmin, stock redistribution is now available in this area too.
But ... you haven't granted me authorization yet.
If you want to restore stock redistribution here, we should head back to ⟦key|the Hub base⟧ first to handle the upgrade authorization.
Endmin, I've reestablished contact with nearby affiliates.
If you want to restore stock redistribution here, we can begin right now.
